why_it_works: This ad leverages the 'health convenience' angle by transforming a trendy health practice (celery juice) into an easy-to-consume gummy format. The heart-shaped gummies create positive emotional associations while the clinical testing claim adds credibility. The green color psychology reinforces the natural/healthy positioning, and the '5g fiber' callout addresses a specific health benefit that resonates with health-conscious consumers. The clean, minimalist design suggests purity and quality.
visual_elements: Clear glass bottle with white cap, bright green label wrapped around middle section, dark green heart-shaped gummies spilling out, white background, sans-serif typography in white on green label, circular badge with '5g FIBER', heart icon, 'Clean Label Project CERTIFIED' badge at bottom right, 'Vegan' circular badge, product count '60' in bottom left, clinically tested actives claim in rounded rectangle
composition: Centered product shot with diagonal arrangement - bottle positioned at slight angle with gummies artfully scattered in front, creating dynamic flow from top left to bottom right. Clean white background with soft shadow. Approximately 4:5 aspect ratio vertical orientation.
angle: Health optimization through convenience - positions celery juice (a known health trend) in an accessible format, emphasizing clinical testing for credibility and specific functional benefits (detoxification, fiber content)
audience: Health-conscious millennials and Gen X (25-45), predominantly female, interested in wellness trends but seeking convenience. Solution-aware audience who knows about celery juice benefits but finds juicing inconvenient. Values clean ingredients, plant-based options, and clinically-backed supplements.

product_presence.description: Dark green heart-shaped gummies in a clear glass bottle with white cap and bright green label
